services.name: General Pest Control
services.description: Monthly and quarterly residential pest service throughout Marion County — ants, roaches, silverfish, and other common invaders treated with products safe around kids and pets. Homes stay on a 30-day or 90-day cycle with text reminders before each visit.

services.name: Termite Treatment and Prevention
services.description: Liquid termiticide perimeter treatments and annual inspections for active infestations or preventive coverage. Subterranean and drywood termites both handled; treatments carry a renewable service agreement.

services.name: Rodent Removal
services.description: Exclusion work to seal entry points, trapping for active rats or mice, and ongoing bait-station monitoring. Most residential rodent cases resolved within two to three service calls.

services.name: Mosquito and Outdoor Pest Control
services.description: Seasonal mosquito fogging and standing-water surveys for yards, pool decks, and outdoor living spaces. Most commonly requested April through October in Central Florida's humid season.

serviceAreaRegion: Marion County, Florida + neighboring Citrus County communities
